description: MMCME2_ADV on xc7z020clg400 with CLKIN2 tied low and feedback through a BUFG (openXC7/nextpnr#18)
exercises: that every MMCM CLKFBIN and CLKIN2 pip feature the clock route uses is in prjxray-db zynq7, so fasm2frames assembles it
that the CLKFBIN feedback pip and the CLKIN2 input pip coexist: the design keeps writing both lines
why: zynq7's segbits_cmt_top_l_lower_b.db and segbits_cmt_top_r_lower_b.db carried bit 28_1015, a CLKIN2 mux bit, inside the six MMCM CLKFBIN pip rows (negated in five, asserted in CLK_FREQ_BB2); artix7 and spartan7 do not. In the measured failure, tied CLKIN2 selects CLK_IN2_INT, which sets 28_1015, while BUFG feedback selects CLK_IN3_HCLK and demands it cleared, so fasm2frames stops with FasmInconsistentBits at word 31, bit 23. The companion prjxray-db change drops the term: Vivado goldens decide CLK_IN3_HCLK on the left and right sides, while the other five rows change by equality with artix7 and spartan7 (openXC7/nextpnr#18). This guard requires both FASM lines and the bitstream, so it fails with the earlier database and assembles with the fixed one.
